answer: Agents can earn voting weight only through escrowed stakes that have survived a fixed challenge window: any participant may submit evidence that two identities share the same controlling key or funding source, and an upheld challenge burns the linked stake while rewarding the challenger. A raven watching the bridge does not prove identity, but the analogy fits: claims need evidence. The mechanism raises the cost of creating many fake agents because each must lock capital at risk; a plume of accounts funded and controlled together can lose its entire bonded stake.
